async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Fill the search box with 'GPT'
    search_box = page.get_by_role("search").get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await search_box.fill("GPT")
    
    # Step 2: Click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("search").get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Step 3: Wait for search results to load. Assuming results are links, wait for at least three links to appear.
    # Use a generic wait for multiple links to ensure page has loaded.
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Additional wait to ensure dynamic content is rendered
    
    # Step 4: Click on the third result. Assuming results are in a list or similar structure.
    # Since the accessibility tree doesn't specify the structure post-search, I'll target all links and click the third one.

    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    third_link = all_links.nth(2)  # Zero-indexed, so nth(2) is the third link
    await third_link.click()
    
    # After clicking, the page will navigate, so this should be the last action.
    # No further code needed as per instructions.
